method: Directional public web-search sample, not a complete index report or stable rank tracker.

comparison.meaning: The technical search foundation is live, but this sample still does not show that the official website is findable by name or by a broad game search. It does not prove global non-indexing.

limitations: Results vary by engine, location, time, language, device and personalization. No result count, ranking, impression, click, visitor, player or play total can be inferred from this sample.
